stub_vector.fs: Strata cleaning is the scheduled cleaning of a building's shared areas – a trained team keeps foyers, lifts, carparks and amenities to a documented standard.

stub_vector.h2: What does a strata clean include?
stub_vector.fs: A strata clean covers foyers, lifts, carparks and shared amenities on every scheduled visit – each area scoped and quality-checked.

stub_vector.h2: How does a strata cleaning contract run?
stub_vector.fs: Every strata cleaning contract runs the same four steps – site audit, scope plan, team assignment, supervisor QA.

stub_vector.h2: What reporting does strata cleaning carry?
stub_vector.fs: Strata cleaning carries a reporting rhythm – visit logs, photo records and a supervisor sign-off the strata manager files with each invoice.
Strata cleaning prices follow building size, visit frequency and access points – written as a monthly invoice after a site audit.

stub_vector.h2: How often should common areas be cleaned?
stub_vector.fs: Common-area frequency follows traffic – foyers and lifts need daily attention, carparks and shared amenities a weekly cycle.
